title: Paired type specimen posters
slide_intent: Compare a family across background treatments because contrast affects hierarchy and perceived weight.
strategic_value: Consistent numeral and alphabet organization can make the Lufthansa family identifiable on both pale and dark fields.
demonstration: Two posters share oversized numerals, alphabets, crane marks and weight specimens; one is gray and one dark blue.
practical_value: Test the same type hierarchy in light and dark versions.

content_islands.name: Poster pair
content_islands.spec: Place the gray specimen at left and blue specimen at right.

content_islands.name: Repeated hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Keep large numerals above alphabets and smaller family samples.
